coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Two of nine ground-truth variable items are identifiable matches: an FP16 reference baseline and WikiText-2 perplexity as a measured outcome. The remaining required variables are incomplete, unspecified, or inconsistent with the ground truth.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The design omits the 70B model, does not explicitly identify all four required methods or all three bit widths, and does not establish weight-only quantization with FP16 inputs and KV caches or per-column asymmetric quantization. It adds PTB/C4 without specifying the fixed 2048 sequence length. Accuracy-based collapse metrics do not match the required Inf/NaN output-stability measurement.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth findings.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No results or conclusions are supplied about QuaRot-GPTQ's low-precision improvements, RTN failures, partial RTN stabilization, or the 70B W2 perplexity reduction from 25.30 to 5.60.
